$description: Reito UI original Graphite design language. DTCG 2025.10 typed token values; themes and density are project-specific groups, not a DTCG theme standard.

inspector-height.$description: Stable working height for developer inspection dialogs; constrained by the viewport.

text-2xs.$description: Micro text step (11px) for tags, counts and dense captions.

text-3xs.$description: Smallest text step (10px); dense micro labels only.

focus-width.$description: Neutral keyboard focus outline width; separate from error and structural outline roles.

menu-font-size.$description: Main text in popup choices and action menus; matches the shared interface font.

validation-glow-blur.$description: Soft validation glow fades inward from the control edge.

validation-glow-width.$description: Inset spread of validation glow; does not change control geometry.

focus.$description: Neutral keyboard focus; status accents retain their own color roles.

sunken.$description: Recessed row surface inside cards and panels; darker than surface in dark themes, the canvas tone in light themes so status text keeps contrast.

focus.$description: Neutral keyboard focus; status accents retain their own color roles.

sunken.$description: Recessed row surface inside cards and panels; darker than surface in dark themes, the canvas tone in light themes so status text keeps contrast.

table-expander-size.$description: Table disclosure actions align with XS action controls in the active density.

compact-surface-padding-x.$description: Reusable inset for compact panel headers, bodies and action rows; follows the active density.

compact-surface-padding-y.$description: Vertical inset is smaller than horizontal inset; shared by compact surfaces.

compact-surface-gap.$description: Spacing between related text blocks inside compact surfaces; use instead of stacking paragraph padding.

menu-item-padding-x.$description: Horizontal text inset shared by action menus.

menu-item-padding-y.$description: Vertical row inset shared by action menus; smaller than horizontal inset.

button-height.$description: Default text and icon button height; matches compact confirmation actions without changing form control height.

card-padding-x.$description: Horizontal inset shared by card header, content and actions; greater than vertical inset.

card-padding-y.$description: Vertical inset on each bordered card region, without root padding or inter-region gap.

card-text-gap.$description: Related title, description and body spacing within an uninterrupted card content region.

button-padding-x.$description: Horizontal inset of default action buttons.

action-footer-padding-y.$description: Vertical inset for default dialog action footers; paired with the wider horizontal content inset.

font-interface.$description: Interface text size; Tailwind text-sm. Dense uses 12px.

font-caption.$description: Caption and code text size; Tailwind text-xs.

font-micro.$description: Micro text size for tags and counts; Tailwind text-2xs.

action-font-size.$description: Default action, tab, toggle and trigger text size.

icon-size.$description: Default inline icon size in rows, menus and actions.

popup-item-padding-x.$description: Horizontal inset of popup menu items inside the popup padding.

switch-height.$description: Default switch track height. Compact matches the foundation size.

switch-width.$description: Default switch track width. Compact matches the foundation size.

switch-height-sm.$description: Small switch track height. Compact matches the foundation size.

switch-width-sm.$description: Small switch track width. Compact matches the foundation size.

item-padding-y.$description: Value is the compact fallback; the Reito CSS expression derives single-line inset from target height. Multi-line items grow naturally.

popup-radius.$description: Popup corner radius; concentric with item-radius plus popup-padding.

popup-padding.$description: Inset between the popup edge and its items.

item-gap.$description: Gap between an item icon, label and trailing content.

inset-padding-x.$description: Label start inset for inset items and check/radio indicator columns: item padding + icon + gap.

separator-inset.$description: Horizontal inset of separators from the popup padding edge.

padding-y.$description: Fixed viewport edge for inset scroll areas; content rows own their own vertical spacing.
